title: 航空熱障塗層評估
summary: 以「用熱阻、膨脹不匹配和循環證據評估熱障塗層」為主線，在塗層熱循環與熱像資料台中依序完成厚度導熱與表背面差、熱膨脹不匹配的自由差、塗層系統多時間尺度、界面回波與分層提示、模型與熱像的空間殘差及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Evaluate thermal barriers through resistance, mismatch and cyclic evidence in a Coating thermal-cycle and thermography data bench, progressing through Thickness conduction and front-back gradient, Free thermal-expansion mismatch, Multiple coating-system timescales, Interface echoes and delamination cues, Spatial residuals between model and thermography, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 厚度導熱與表背面差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Thickness conduction and front-back gradient: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 厚度導熱與表背面差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Thickness conduction and front-back gradient and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空熱障塗層評估」中，本單元處理「厚度導熱與表背面差」。薄層的熱阻與厚度成正比、與導熱係數成反比；增加熱阻可能保護基材卻提高表面溫度。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aerospace thermal-barrier coating assessment, this unit examines Thickness conduction and front-back gradient. Thin-layer resistance grows with thickness and decreases with conductivity; greater resistance can protect the substrate while heating the surface.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：厚度 L=0.0005 m、導熱係數 k=1.5 W/(m K)、熱流密度 q=200000 W/m²。關係式 ΔT=qL/k；含輸出單位換算的算式 200000*0.0005/1.5，結果 66.666667 K。適用範圍：一維定常且材料均質，不含孔隙演化、輻射與界面剝離。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Thickness L=0.0005 m, conductivity k=1.5 W/(m K) and heat flux q=200000 W/m². Relation ΔT=qL/k; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 200000*0.0005/1.5 gives 66.666667 K. Applicability: Homogeneous one-dimensional steady conduction excluding pore evolution, radiation and delamination.
steps.failure: 在「厚度導熱與表背面差」的情境中，局部剝離形成額外熱阻，可能在熱像上呈現異常但非單一厚度差。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Thickness conduction and front-back gradient, Delamination adds thermal resistance, so a thermal anomaly need not be a thickness difference.
steps.check: 針對「厚度導熱與表背面差」，以已知厚度試片做相同熱邊界比較，區別塗層與界面熱阻。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Thickness conduction and front-back gradient, Compare known-thickness coupons under matched thermal boundaries and separate coating/interface resistance. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 L 改為0.0008 m，其餘條件固定。用 200000*0.0008/1.5 重算，結果從 66.666667 變成 106.66667 K。先預測方向，再記下對「厚度導熱與表背面差」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only L to 0.0008 m, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 200000*0.0008/1.5: 66.666667 becomes 106.66667 K. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Thickness conduction and front-back gradient, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「航空熱障塗層評估」的「厚度導熱與表背面差：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Thickness conduction and front-back gradient: Mechanism and observation” in “Aerospace thermal-barrier coating assessment”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 在「航空熱障塗層評估」中，本單元處理「界面接觸熱阻分配」。接觸、傳導和對流熱阻可在單一路徑串接；平行散熱路徑不能直接相加。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aerospace thermal-barrier coating assessment, this unit examines Interface thermal-resistance allocation. Contact, conduction and convection resistances add along one path; parallel cooling paths do not add directly.

steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation.
